author: Bellular News
description:
Halo Studios shipped Campaign Evolved. Then the contractors who built it were out of work, including one who had spent 6.5 years on Halo. Xbox says there were no layoffs because none of them were internal staff. That technicality gets to the heart of how Microsoft keeps mishandling the series.
